map.输入超声肾盂前后径(APD)与 SFU 分级，量化肾积水程度及处理建议: Enter the ultrasound renal pelvic anteroposterior diameter (APD) and SFU grade to quantify hydronephrosis severity and get management advice
map.肾积水分级（肾盂前后径 APD）：胎儿 小于5mm 正常、5 至 10 轻度、1: Hydronephrosis grading (pelvic anteroposterior diameter APD): fetal less than 5mm normal, 5 to 10 mild, 10 to 15 moderate, not below 15 severe; adult less than 15 mild, 15 to 20 moderate, not below 20 severe; SFU grades 0 to 4 (including calyceal dilatation and cortical thinning).
map.2级 - 肾盂+大肾盏扩张: Grade 2 - pelvis plus major calyces dilated
map.3级 - 肾盂+大/小肾盏扩张，皮质正常: Grade 3 - pelvis plus major/minor calyces dilated, cortex normal
map.明确梗阻部位，评估肾功能: Identify the obstruction site, assess renal function
map.尽早解除梗阻，保护肾功能: Relieve the obstruction early, preserve renal function
map.胎儿肾盂分离：<5mm正常，5-10mm需随访，>10mm或伴肾盏扩张提示病理性: Fetal pelvic separation: <5mm normal, 5-10mm needs follow-up, >10mm or with calyceal dilatation suggests pathology.
map.肾盂+大/小肾盏扩张，皮质正常: Pelvis plus major/minor calyces dilated, cortex normal
map.极重度（肾功能受损风险）: Very severe (risk of impaired renal function)
map.重度肾积水(SFU 4级 / APD>20mm / 皮质<5mm)提示肾功能受损: Severe hydronephrosis (SFU grade 4 / APD >20mm / cortex <5mm) indicates impaired renal function; relieve the obstruction promptly (stent/nephrostomy/surgery) and perform renal scintigraphy to assess split renal function.
map.⚠️ 肾积水病因多样（结石、肿瘤、狭窄、UPJ梗阻等），本工具仅评估程度，病因诊: ⚠️ Hydronephrosis has many causes (stones, tumor, stricture, UPJ obstruction and others); this tool only assesses severity, and etiologic diagnosis requires comprehensive imaging judgment.
map.成人 APD 25mm（≥20 提示梗阻）、SFU 3 级（肾盂+大/小肾盏、皮: Adult APD 25mm (>=20 suggests obstruction), SFU grade 3 (pelvis plus major/minor calyces, cortex normal): relieve the obstruction to preserve the kidney.
map.胎儿肾盂前后径轻扩、SFU 2 级，多可随访观察，产后复查超声。: Fetal renal pelvis mildly dilated, SFU grade 2: mostly suitable for follow-up observation, with postnatal ultrasound recheck.
map.0 无、1 肾盂、2 +大盏、3 +小盏皮质正常、4 +皮质变薄；成人 APD≥: 0 none, 1 pelvis, 2 plus major calyces, 3 plus minor calyces with normal cortex, 4 plus cortical thinning; adults with APD >=20mm or SFU >=4 need active management.
map.皮质厚度反映肾功能储备。肾盂分离同样为 25 mm 时，皮质厚度 15 mm 与: Cortical thickness reflects renal functional reserve. With the same pelvic separation of 25 mm, a cortex of 15 mm versus 5 mm calls for completely different urgency: marked cortical thinning (<5 mm) means prolonged high pressure has already damaged the parenchyma, and even after relieving the obstruction functional recovery is limited, so management should be more aggressive.
map.关于「肾积水(肾盂分离)程度量化器」: About the Hydronephrosis (Renal Pelvis Separation) Severity Quantifier
map.肾积水(肾盂分离)程度量化器 - 超声肾盂前后径APD结合SFU分级，量化肾积水: Hydronephrosis (Renal Pelvis Separation) Severity Quantifier - ultrasound renal pelvic APD combined with SFU grading to quantify hydronephrosis severity and renal function risk. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
